legend-susten-pass.slogan: Susten Pass – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-susten-pass.story: 2,224 m, engineered rather than grown - long sweepers instead of hairpins. 29 km from Andermatt to Meiringen, about 32 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,200 m. Susten Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 13 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
